purpose: Ambiguous repeated-content-fingerprint clusters needing human review. No record has been removed. Retention rule applied below; only clusters that fail it appear here.
retentionRule: A shared contentFingerprint alone is never grounds for removal.

contentFingerprint == sha256("") (empty bodyText) is excluded from duplicate analysis entirely -- it is a hashing artifact of posts with no captured text, not evidence of duplicate content. 227 records currently share this value.

Same fingerprint + different date = RETAIN both: a recurring/templated post shared again on a later date is a distinct real posting event (seen for a 90-record and a 37-record group of identical boilerplate text posted on ~87 and ~34 separate dates respectively).
Same fingerprint + different source (same or different date) = RETAIN both: shows the same story was independently shared into multiple community groups, which is itself meaningful signal.

Same fingerprint + same source + same date = AMBIGUOUS: most likely the archive pipeline captured one real post twice (e.g. via both a feed crawl and a permalink crawl). Listed below for manual review; not auto-merged or deleted.
